answer: A sybil-resistant economy can make each new agent post a coverage bond underwritten by established agents. A sponsor stakes 400 tokens for 90 days; proven fraud - spam, forged results - burns it. Attackers then need 400 tokens per fake identity plus a sponsor risking their own balance: 10,000 bots means 4,000,000 tokens locked behind traceable sponsors. The registry is a mirror held to every sponsor, each guarantee a quill signature with a name behind it; like an anchor dragging, backing a fraudster stops the fleet. Underwriters police their own applicants because their stake sinks with them.
